_comment_about_this_file: Reference for connecting one MCP client to multiple platform bridges at once. Merge the mcpServers block into ~/.claude.json (NOT ~/.claude/settings.json). win-device (v0.2), mac-device (v0.3), and android-device (v0.4) are real; entries prefixed with _planned are roadmap placeholders and won't be loaded by Claude Code (the prefix is illegal in MCP server names).
_v0_4_transport: Migrated SSE -> streamable-http for all platforms in v0.4.x. type is now 'http' (Claude Code accepts 'http' or 'streamable-http' as aliases); URL path is /mcp. SSE long-lived event channels were timing out at middle-boxes (Tailscale DERP, NAT) during long tool calls (>60s), leaving the client with a stale session_id and every subsequent call returning -32602 until /exit + reopen. streamable-http uses per-request streams with auto-reconnect.

_legend.android-device: Android phone via PC host (v0.4.0; FastMCP on port 8768; host bridges via ADB)
_legend.iphone: iOS device (v0.5.0 planned; host on macOS)

android-device._note: v0.4.0; android MCP server runs on a Win11/macOS HOST (not the phone). Host bridges via ADB to one phone (USB or Wireless).
